registers.name: OCR
registers.description: Operation Conditions: VCC voltage window, busy bit, access-mode (byte vs sector addressing). Read/poll via CMD1.

registers.name: CID
registers.description: Device identification: MID, OEM/App ID, product name/revision, serial number, manufacturing date. CMD2/CMD10.

registers.name: CSD
registers.description: Device-specific data: TAAC/NSAC, max data rate, command classes (CCC), block lengths, legacy capacity. CMD9.

registers.name: EXT_CSD
registers.description: 512-byte Extended CSD: Properties (read-only capabilities) + Modes (host-writable config). CMD8 read / CMD6 SWITCH write.

registers.name: RCA
registers.description: Relative Device Address assigned by CMD3.

base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: Module memory map per spec. Reads from reserved bits return zeros and writes to reserved bits have no effect.
